tei:div.tei:p: brgyud pa'i kha skong ni/ rnam smin tshe dbang phyag chen rig pa 'dzin// sku lnga lhun grub rdo rje 'chang chen po// ye shes rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis rtag rol ba// lhun grub rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// lta spyod dkyil 'khor dbang bskur dam tshig dang*// mchod sngags ting 'dzin phrin las sgrub pa yis// pad+ma'i bstan 'dzin dgos 'byung nor bu'i dbyig /pad+ma nor bu'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med chos skur rtogs// phrin las rtag khyab lhun grub dpal dang ldan// mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar rmad du byung*// chos dpal bzang po'i zhabs= /sdom gsum gnang bkag gtsang ma pad+ma'i tshal// legs bshad mgrin glu sgrog pa'i sbra ma ra// zab rgyas chos kyi sbyin pa 'gyed mkhas pa// pad+ma sbyin pa'i zhabs la= pad+ma'i bka' srol snga 'gyur bstan la zhugs// dka' thub bzod pa'i go cha cher bsgos pas// tshe gcig grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs// pad+ma bzod pa'i zhabs la= phyag na pad+mo'i gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul gar/ snga 'gyur mdo sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// bstan 'gro'i don chen 328)sgrub pa'i mthu stobs can// mdo sngags bstan 'dzin zhabs la= phyogs dus rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po nyi ma'i gnyen// rab 'byams 'gro khams rgya mtsho'i gtsug na brjid// chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rmad byung legs bshad= sogs dang sbrel/ zhes pa'ang thub bstan chos kyi glang pos sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba btab pa dge/ bkra shis//
